Spring... The season of Classic races had 
arrived. The Trainer pondered the plan for 
which races she should enter going 
forward.

Around that time, the two of them happen 
to watch footage of a race featuring the 
"Triple Crown Umamusume," Narita Brian.

Watching Narita Brian run, the Trainer 
couldn't help but feel regret, wishing 
that Mayano Top Gun had a rival like her.

As the Trainer continued to watch footage 
of Narita Brian afterward, Mayano Top Gun, 
overcome with jealousy, shouted that they 
should look only at her.

Determined to monopolize her Trainer's 
attention, Mayano Top Gun set a serious 
goal to surpass Narita Brian.
